goal: Defeat Team Rocket in Silph Co.

subgoals.goal_text: Travel to Saffron City from Route 12.
Enter the Silph Co. building in Saffron City.
Fight through the first floor of Silph Co. to reach the elevator.
Use the elevator to move through the building, fighting Team Rocket members on each floor.
Locate Giovanni on the 11th floor of Silph Co.
Battle and defeat Giovanni to liberate Silph Co.
